user_approved_parent_weights.approval_source: Current user explicitly selected 沿用品質70%、效能30%（建議）

assumptions_not_misrepresented_as_origin: Historical memory-pressure and TTFT/TPS score bounds were not located; these are explicit current-selection mappings, not a recovered approved original formula.
The historical 10% memory item is provisionally split equally into RAM and VRAM efficiency (5% each). These are whole-system/device sampled proxies, not model-process pressure.
The historical 17.5% Logical/Arithmetic item is pooled across fixed 37+13 source-qualified tasks; weights 12.95% and 4.55% give each of the 50 tasks equal credit.
Primary success requires frozen-source content plus original format/source/citation program checks. A content-only sensitivity analysis separately exposes known gate false negatives.

normalization.higher_quality: Original bounded 0..1; cosine uses max(0,min(1,cosine)), not four-model minmax. Actual cohort cosines are positive.
normalization.ttft_ram_vram: Best (lowest) paired cohort mean / model paired cohort mean
normalization.tps: Model paired cohort mean / best (highest) paired cohort mean
normalization.direction: Higher normalized score is better for every term
normalization.cohort_dependency: Scores depend on this four-model cohort and machine; not transferable universal percentages.

policy.judge_relevance_reason: Retained independently; original relevance requirement is BGE-M3, so do not blend two relevance measures or double count.
policy.context_precision_reason: Shared retrieval, fixed exploratory 12-question sample; cannot distinguish model quality.
policy.missing_values: No N/A filled with zero. TTFT uses the same 179 nonmissing questions for all four models; other continuous metrics use paired common samples. Fixed-task non-success follows the pre-existing denominator rule.
policy.sample_limits: 50 source-qualified questions, 10 source groups, 3 original files; AI source QA, not expert truth or unseen holdout
